transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. How are you today? What brings you in?
Hello, Dr. Smith. To be honest, I haven't been doing very well lately. I've been feeling extremely down, really anxious, and I'm just having a very hard time coping with everything.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It has been going on for about a month now. It started shortly after a major change in my life, and it feels like it's just getting harder to manage each day.
Can you tell me more about the major change that happened around that time?

There was a really significant change in my life recently, but to be honest, I'm not even sure how to detail it or put it into words right now. Everything has just felt so overwhelming since it happened, and it's hard to explain.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with people?

Yes, I really have. I've stopped doing my usual hobbies and have been pulling away from my friends and family, mostly just staying home alone. I just don't have the energy or interest to do any of the things I used to enjoy.
How is this affecting your ability to work, study, or handle daily responsibilities?

I've really been struggling to keep up with my daily tasks and focus lately. To be honest, I'm not entirely sure how to describe the exact impact, but everything just feels incredibly hard to manage right now.
Have you been feeling down or irritable most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks?

Yes, I have been feeling incredibly down and hopeless almost every single day. But it's actually been going on for about a month now, rather than just two weeks. It has been really hard to shake this feeling.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that you'd be better off dead?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or wishing I was dead. Things have been incredibly hard lately, but I've never thought about doing anything like that.
Was the onset of your symptoms clearly within one month of the stressful life event?
Yes, absolutely. The feelings of anxiety and sadness started almost immediately, definitely within a week or two after the event happened. It was a very sudden and clear shift for me.
Have your symptoms improved at all since they started, or have they remained significant over the past month?
No, they haven't improved at all. They have remained really significant and constant for the entire past month, and it feels just as hard to cope now as it did in the beginning.

Thank you for sharing. Based on what you've told me, it sounds like you've been experiencing a significant stress-related reaction. I'd like to discuss how we can support your recovery and coping moving forward.
Thank you, Dr. Smith, I would really appreciate that. I'm honestly not sure how to start feeling better on my own, so I am very open to hearing what steps or support options you would recommend.
